supersedes.supersession_scope: construction instrumentation and candidate acceptance only; prior run remains interrupted and immutable

scope.candidate_universe: the exact pinned eligible training groups from the parent contract

CM100.definition: sum of global frozen-v0.8 static rarity-weighted coverage priority ranks over all eligible training groups
CM100.score_order: descending five-axis v0.8 global rarity-weighted coverage score, then ascending SHA256(curated_seed|group_id), then lexical group_id

RM100.definition: sum of seeded SHA256 random-priority ranks over all eligible training groups
RM100.score_order: ascending SHA256(random_seed|group_id), then lexical group_id; priority rank is eligible_count minus zero-based rank
RM100.interpretation: deterministic constrained random-priority objective; not uniform sampling from the feasible-bank set

objectives.feasible_candidate_policy: accept only a distinct candidate that passes every independent hard-constraint audit; report OPTIMAL or FEASIBLE_NOT_PROVEN and all available valid bounds

separation_gate.CM100: SEPARATED iff candidate is non-identical, independently feasible, and curated objective sum exceeds R100 identity objective sum by at least one integer priority unit
separation_gate.RM100: SEPARATED iff candidate is non-identical, independently feasible, and random-priority sum exceeds C100 identity objective sum by at least one integer priority unit
separation_gate.absolute_threshold_justification: one is the smallest positive difference representable by the frozen integer-sum objective; it prevents zero-change candidates but makes no claim of material learning impact
separation_gate.headroom_metric: (candidate objective - identity objective)/(valid upper bound - identity objective); report raw components; null when denominator is non-positive
separation_gate.upper_bound: sum of the top frozen priority ranks required within each exact joint cell; this relaxes all remaining constraints and is valid but may be loose
separation_gate.zero_headroom_denominator: report null and explain; do not divide

statuses.search_exhaustion_semantics: construction budget ended; never evidence of infeasibility or absence of treatment headroom

construction.witness_use: initial state only; establish profile feasibility; must be changed before candidate acceptance
stages: input/root bundle exchanges where incidence permits
construction.compression_rule: only merge candidates when every relevant constraint contribution is preserved, the objective is additive over the class, and no residual constraint distinguishes members; expand and independently revalidate

budget.wall_clock_limit_reproducibility_caveat: same seed and one worker are fixed; wall-clock cutoffs may yield different incumbents across machines; preserve trace and artifact hashes

decision_policy.valid_bank_and_separation_pass: independent audit then separate explicit LFM authorization gate; no automatic model contact
decision_policy.budget_exhaustion: report SEARCH_EXHAUSTED; retain best audited candidate; do not infer low headroom
decision_policy.p_star: unchanged; invoke only under original source-support infeasibility conditions
